b_01KXA5CGPMGEA4A2H9FZKN3SXV.subject: septic_critical_path_risk
b_01KXA5CGPMGEA4A2H9FZKN3SXV.content: TDEC septic inspection is an explicit pre-construction requirement per the scope document. The TDEC process takes 4–8 weeks end-to-end, making it the longest single lead time in the project and a probable determinant of whether the 2026-10-05 start date is achievable.
b_01KXA5CGPMGEA4A2H9FZKN3SXV.falsification_test: TDEC process already initiated and permit in hand would reduce this risk; 'Not applicable' determination would eliminate it.

b_01KXA5CGPMC8NFMJ2FPJZPTXRK.subject: roof_tie_in_concealed_condition_risk
b_01KXA5CGPMC8NFMJ2FPJZPTXRK.content: The new 3/12 roof must integrate with an existing 6/12 pitch roof; structural conditions above the existing ceiling are concealed until demo opens them, creating change-order exposure and requiring a post-opening schedule buffer per addition rules.
b_01KXA5CGPMC8NFMJ2FPJZPTXRK.falsification_test: Structural drawings or prior inspection confirming existing rafter/truss condition and load capacity would reduce this risk.

b_01KXA5CGPMSC4P6KZ35RR5QY22.subject: subpanel_service_verification_status
b_01KXA5CGPMSC4P6KZ35RR5QY22.content: A 100-amp subpanel is in scope, but existing main service capacity is listed only as an assumption in the scope document. Addition rules require a pre-construction amperage check task before the subpanel scope is finalized.
b_01KXA5CGPMSC4P6KZ35RR5QY22.falsification_test: A documented load calculation or electrician verification showing adequate main service headroom would resolve this.
